standing: PROPOSED C1c-1 description successor: two inherited rows whose raw text C1c-1 made false or incomplete, and one whose current reviewed meaning it made false; parent inventory v242; the four adopted law files by value. Independent review and root assent required.

passageOverrides.after: Seal a walked capture session into snapshot2 (M3-C r8 items 1, 4, 5 and 6; unit C1a3, preparatory library): the leftover and project-carrier joins, kind:none only for the lending's NoRepository proof with no admitted member, the row, canonical-descriptor and total-byte bounds in order, and the canonical inventory retained in custody, every allocation charged first; and, when the session read a read set, its guard (Unit C1c-1 (C1c plan r4 with addenda guard-charge r2 and unobservable-name r2), LD-C1C-7 as amended by LD-C1C-7A): its own allocation-free pass over the inventory before the bounds, every read-set row below its chosen admitted package by a suffix that stays in that package with no excluded path at or above it, each check and its measuring pass charged first; with no layout and no read set it charges nothing more. No caller.

passageSupersessions.before: M3-C r8 items 1 and 3 (unit C1c-0; C1c plan r4): the read set's security primitives, ahead of the read set itself (C1c-1). open_pruned is the pruned-tree capture opener for C2's layout reads: from the retained root by no-follow opens, each directory observed through its parent, opened and compared, judged under S3 directory custody above the dependency anchor only and under descriptor discipline at and below it, an installed manifest never judged under config-file custody, and a path with no dependency segment, a VCS segment or a custody anchor refused before any open. authorize_read is the shared rule's read_set_path over the full path with the same session's walk evidence (WalkEvidence), charged its counted cost; observes_dependency_cargo_root is the charged no-follow Cargo.toml observation. Unit C2b-0 (C2b plan r3) adds the node_modules layout's primitives beside the opener: reach_directory, the no-follow directory reach from the retained root, judged under S3 directory custody above the first node_modules segment or throughout a first-party path and under the descriptor discipline at and below it; list_directory, a reached directory's listing at the walk's price, dot names dropped and every other name observed no-follow; read_link, one charged readlinkat of a symlink's stored text through the held descriptor, never followed (None for a text that is not UTF-8); observe_entry and reached_dependency_cargo_root, no-follow observations; layout_exclusion, the extent's and the shared rule's excluded_path judgment of one path, charged before either runs; and resolve_link with resolve_link_cost, the lexical resolution of a link's text, which opens and follows nothing. Opens descriptors and reads no regular-file content: the only bytes it reads are a symlink's stored text, by read_link, and source contents are read only by crates/host/src/snapshot.rs; every step charged to the caller's ledger first; library only, with no production caller.
passageSupersessions.after: M3-C r8 items 1 and 3 (unit C1c-0; C1c plan r4): the read set's security primitives, and from unit C1c-1 the read set's reader (below). open_pruned is the pruned-tree capture opener for C2's layout reads: from the retained root by no-follow opens, each directory observed through its parent, opened and compared, judged under S3 directory custody above the dependency anchor only and under descriptor discipline at and below it, an installed manifest never judged under config-file custody, and a path with no dependency segment, a VCS segment or a custody anchor refused before any open. authorize_read is the shared rule's read_set_path over the full path with the same session's walk evidence (WalkEvidence), charged its counted cost; observes_dependency_cargo_root is the charged no-follow Cargo.toml observation. Unit C2b-0 (C2b plan r3) adds the node_modules layout's primitives beside the opener: reach_directory, the no-follow directory reach from the retained root, judged under S3 directory custody above the first node_modules segment or throughout a first-party path and under the descriptor discipline at and below it; list_directory, a reached directory's listing at the walk's price, dot names dropped and every other name observed no-follow; read_link, one charged readlinkat of a symlink's stored text through the held descriptor, never followed (None for a text that is not UTF-8); observe_entry and reached_dependency_cargo_root, no-follow observations; layout_exclusion, the extent's and the shared rule's excluded_path judgment of one path, charged before either runs; and resolve_link with resolve_link_cost, the lexical resolution of a link's text, which opens and follows nothing. Unit C1c-1 (C1c plan r4 with addenda guard-charge r2 and unobservable-name r2) adds walk_read_set, the reader over the layouts' sorted, unique realPaths with the same session's walk extent and evidence: each package judged before any open (read_set_judgment, the extent's exclusion then read_set_path, priced as layout_exclusion is through the shared exclusion_price); reached by reach_components, reach_directory's own component loop, which stops at the parent of a target segment to observe a dependency Cargo.toml first; and descended under held descriptors, each listing converted name by name at the walk's prices and sorted by the charged C3 sort. A regular file with one of the nine read-set suffixes is opened no-follow and handed to the caller with its package's index; a nested package, a VCS or Cargo build-output directory and the extent's exclusions are never descended; a name that is not a logical path and has no suffix is counted only when observed no-follow as a regular file, link or special file (unconverted_disposition); when its refusal is funded, it refuses Name if observed as a directory, found absent, or rejected by the platform's component predicate before any observation, while a native observation failure stays the host's HostIo with its native error, and an unfunded charge is budget exhaustion. Opens descriptors and reads no regular-file content: the only bytes it reads are a symlink's stored text, by read_link, and source contents are read only by crates/host/src/snapshot.rs; every step charged to the caller's ledger first; library only, with no production caller.
